purpose: Pre-production sampling, recruitment and provenance plan for real adult and employer responses. This file is a method plan, not evidence and not proof that any respondent has been recruited.

adults.claim_boundary: Research responses describe respondents only. They are not automatically project participants and cannot prove future project eligibility without the separate official group-target procedure.

employers.claim_boundary: Employer responses are organisational perceptions and reported practices; they do not establish population-wide prevalence without an appropriate probability sample.

sampling_design.type: targeted multi-channel non-probability research with explicit coverage controls
sampling_design.primary_objective: triangulate secondary evidence with direct, real respondent evidence on skill gaps, AI use, barriers, task/process fit and preferred development needs

provisional_readiness_thresholds.note: Thresholds are operational adequacy gates for a non-probability needs study, not statistical power or representativeness claims. QA may require more responses when coverage is materially imbalanced.

allowed_examples: direct neutral invitation through documented research partners

privacy_and_separation.optional_contact_collection: NOT_PART_OF_ANALYTIC_FORM; if later needed, must be a separate unlinked system with its own purpose, notice and retention

duplicate_and_fraud_boundary.same_person_multiple_independent_submiss: cannot be reliably detected without adding identity/device linkage and therefore must be disclosed as a residual limitation
mitigation: neutral invitation asks for one response per person/organisation
channel monitoring for anomalous bursts or structurally identical records without using fingerprinting
sensitivity analysis excludes suspicious batches only when an objective documented rule is met

may_close_collection_only_if: all required GDPR/provider/live-path gates are approved and referenced
both instruments have real valid responses
all three regions meet the provisional minimum coverage thresholds or a documented QA exception explains why further collection is infeasible
no single recruitment channel exceeds the maximum share unless a documented sensitivity analysis shows conclusions are not channel-driven
coverage across major profile dimensions is reported, including empty or sparse cells
adversarial QA tests conclusions with and without dominant channels and sparse strata
source export is frozen, hashed and passes NF06 pre-ingest
must_continue_collection_if: a region or respondent population is absent
a material conclusion depends on a sparse cell
channel concentration materially changes the ranking
privacy or provenance controls are incomplete

allowed: convergence or divergence between adult, employer and secondary evidence
ranked needs with explicit evidence-strength and uncertainty labels
forbidden: population prevalence estimates presented as representative
causal claims from cross-sectional survey responses
treating project activities, planned participant numbers or curricula as proof of need
treating TEST TWIN results as empirical evidence
